title: Interpretation of Scripture
definition: The interpretation of Scripture is the careful, prayerful work of understanding what God has communicated through the biblical text according to its context, grammar, genre, history, and place in the whole Bible.
summary: Faithful interpretation seeks the meaning God intended, not whatever meaning the reader wants to impose. Scripture should be read in context, compared with Scripture, centered on Christ, and applied with humility.
christFocus: Jesus taught that the Scriptures point to Him. Faithful interpretation honors Christ by reading each passage in its biblical context and in light of God's redemptive plan fulfilled in Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Interpretation matters because the Bible can be mishandled. The goal is not cleverness, novelty, or personal preference, but rightly understanding and applying the Word of truth.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Bad interpretation can produce false doctrine, confusion, manipulation, and spiritual harm. Faithful interpretation protects the church and helps disciples grow in truth.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask what the text says, what it means in context, how it points to God's truth and redemptive work, and how believers should respond in faith and obedience.
